results.label: thm:main
results.statement: One fixed finite-dimensional unital complex algebra A has,for each positive m,a finite-dimensional left module N_m with 2m-2<=pd_A(N_m)<infinity.
conditions: A and all lifted complexes are fixed before m;does not assert all modules have finite pd or a uniform module-size bound. No concrete final multiplication table/bases/chain matrices are supplied.
constants_and_constructions: A and all lifted complexes are fixed before m;does not assert all modules have finite pd or a uniform module-size bound. No concrete final multiplication table/bases/chain matrices are supplied.

results.label: cor:left-right-asymmetry
results.statement: A separate finite-dimensional complex algebra Lambda has little/big left dimensions infinite,opposite dimensions zero,and left injectives nongenerating/right injectives generating.
conditions: Auxiliary Lambda from Cummings triangular construction after opposite/Morita transport;no assertion about right dimensions or generation of the original A. All four dimensions use left-module convention.
constants_and_constructions: Auxiliary Lambda from Cummings triangular construction after opposite/Morita transport;no assertion about right dimensions or generation of the original A. All four dimensions use left-module convention.

results.label: prop:selection
results.statement: Fixed finitely presented complex R,central idempotent e and automorphism alpha give H^j(Y_m) nonzero for0<=j<m and H^m(Y_m)=0.
conditions: H(Y)=restriction along alpha of eY;R=C[G] need not be finite-dimensional. Finite quotient has characteristic2,but representations and e=(1+z0)/2 are overC.
constants_and_constructions: H(Y)=restriction along alpha of eY;R=C[G] need not be finite-dimensional. Finite quotient has characteristic2,but representations and e=(1+z0)/2 are overC.

results.label: lem:group-finite-presentation
results.statement: The indexed auxiliary group has a finite presentation on fifteen generators.
conditions: Kernel-lattice centralizers and argument-zero relations suffice;all actually used pairs of weights Z3->Z2 are surjective. No arbitrary extra group relations imported.
constants_and_constructions: Kernel-lattice centralizers and argument-zero relations suffice;all actually used pairs of weights Z3->Z2 are surjective. No arbitrary extra group relations imported.

results.label: lem:central-shift
results.statement: z_N=[U_i(a),V_i(b)],a+b=N,is independent of splitting/internal index,central,involutory,and shifted by an automorphism.
conditions: Central commutator transfer uses the stated cross-index commutations;independence/nontrivial images of whole segments are established separately by finite quotients.
constants_and_constructions: Central commutator transfer uses the stated cross-index commutations;independence/nontrivial images of whole segments are established separately by finite quotients.

results.label: lem:finite-central-quotients
results.statement: For each m,the image in GL5(F2[t]/(t^m-1)) detects independent central z0,...,z_(m-1),giving(C2)^m.
conditions: Ring is finite with monic degree-m basis and t a unit;even m/nonreduced quotient allowed. Matrix image is a quotient,not a faithful representation of all G.
constants_and_constructions: Ring is finite with monic degree-m basis and t a unit;even m/nonreduced quotient allowed. Matrix image is a quotient,not a faithful representation of all G.

results.label: lem:directed-bound
results.statement: Finite-dimensional algebra with n ordered complete orthogonal idempotents,scalar diagonal corners and no backwards components has global dimension<=n-1 on both sides.
conditions: Includes arbitrary modules:successive kernel supports move strictly forward. Applied to B gives<=2;not a bound for arbitrary quiver algebras or final square-zero A.
constants_and_constructions: Includes arbitrary modules:successive kernel supports move strictly forward. Applied to B gives<=2;not a bound for arbitrary quiver algebras or final square-zero A.

results.label: lem:odd-double
results.statement: In an arbitrary triangulated category,a formal idempotent summand U has U+U[1] and U+U[3] represented by old objects in the idempotent completion.
conditions: U itself need not split in the old category;cones and fullness give odd double. No algorithmic/natural splitting or unrestricted strictification claimed.
constants_and_constructions: U itself need not split in the old category;cones and fullness give odd double. No algorithmic/natural splitting or unrestricted strictification claimed.

results.label: lem:diagram-lift
results.statement: Every B-diagram in the chosen Verdier quotient is isomorphic to the image of one B-diagram in the homotopy category.
conditions: Three vertices,two arrow layers,finite relation space;common denominators are cleared before any test module. Relations become zero in homotopy category,not strictly zero chain maps.
constants_and_constructions: Three vertices,two arrow layers,finite relation space;common denominators are cleared before any test module. Relations become zero in homotopy category,not strictly zero chain maps.

results.label: prop:lifted-diagram
results.statement: One fixed collection of bounded right-projective D_i,chain maps f_a and degree-minus-one h_rho realizes the selected diagram under every finite-dimensional evaluation Y.
conditions: d h+h d=sum rho_ba f_b f_a. All choices independent of Y;the source does not provide explicit chosen denominators,bases or null-homotopy matrices.
constants_and_constructions: d h+h d=sum rho_ba f_b f_a. All choices independent of Y;the source does not provide explicit chosen denominators,bases or null-homotopy matrices.

results.label: thm:realization
results.statement: For any field,finitely presented R,central e and unital endomorphism alpha,a single bounded right-projective B-bimodule complex P sends M(Y) to M(HY)+M(HY)[3] by derived tensor.
conditions: P fixed before Y;three-vertex B has global dimension<=2. Objectwise splitting suffices;not a natural splitting,flat ordinary tensor shortcut or a computed finite fixture.
constants_and_constructions: P fixed before Y;three-vertex B has global dimension<=2. Objectwise splitting suffices;not a natural splitting,flat ordinary tensor shortcut or a computed finite fixture.

results.label: lem:rectification
results.statement: The supplied three-vertex homotopy diagram admits a strict bounded right-projective bimodule complex with vertex homotopy equivalences and arrow homotopies.
conditions: Use a basis of quadratic relation space,no paths of length3;d_P=[[d0,p,h],[0,-d1,q],[0,0,d2]],pq=-f_rho,dh+hd=f_rho. Does not rectify arbitrary homotopy actions without higher coherence.
constants_and_constructions: Use a basis of quadratic relation space,no paths of length3;d_P=[[d0,p,h],[0,-d1,q],[0,0,d2]],pq=-f_rho,dh+hd=f_rho. Does not rectify arbitrary homotopy actions without higher coherence.

results.label: prop:ordinary-simulation
results.statement: Finite-dimensional product D and ordinary off-diagonal bimodule X have F^2(Z)=P[b_*] derived-tensored with Z on the first factor.
conditions: Support interval[a_*,b_*],l=b_*-a_* fixed;global dimensions D,Dop<=3l+2;chain isomorphism uses sign(-1)^(b_*n). Neither support endpoints nor final matrices numerically specified.
constants_and_constructions: Support interval[a_*,b_*],l=b_*-a_* fixed;global dimensions D,Dop<=3l+2;chain isomorphism uses sign(-1)^(b_*n). Neither support endpoints nor final matrices numerically specified.

results.label: prop:bar-splitting
results.statement: For a split square-zero A=D semidirect X over a field,and inflated left D-module N,D derived-tensor_A N is directsum_r(F^rN)[r].
conditions: F is genuinely derived tensor;X need not be flat. Absolute bar faces preserve X-count and rescaling corrects signs;direct sums finite in each total degree,not products/completion. N not required finite here.
constants_and_constructions: F is genuinely derived tensor;X need not be flat. Absolute bar faces preserve X-count and rescaling corrects signs;direct sums finite in each total degree,not products/completion. N not required finite here.

results.label: cor:pd-detection
results.statement: With D finite global dimension on both sides and N finite-dimensional,extinction at t>=1 implies finite pd_A;survival at r implies pd_A>=r,including infinite pd.
conditions: Iterates have cohomology in[-rg,0];minimal resolution/Nakayama detects finiteness after semisimple base change. Lower bound uses iterate index,not an invented estimate of shifts.
constants_and_constructions: Iterates have cohomology in[-rg,0];minimal resolution/Nakayama detects finiteness after semisimple base change. Lower bound uses iterate index,not an invented estimate of shifts.

unlabelled_results.statement: For j>=0,Phi^j(M(Y)) is the direct sum of M(H^jY)[3q] with binomial(j,q) multiplicities.
conditions: Finite-dimensional Y,derived tensor,objectwise finite sums/shifts;no natural choice of truncation splittings needed.
constants_and_constructions: q=0..j,shift3q;the later ordinary simulation adds j*b_* separately.
